# Polygonal Mind CC0 3D assets

- Source repository: <https://github.com/ToxSam/cc0-models-Polygonal-Mind>
- Original creator: Polygonal Mind
- Pinned source commit: `56db2d4088512531a070d0bf3eb9d284d077528d`
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal

The selected GLB files under `tomb_chaser_2/` and `lunar_year/` are imported
unchanged from the pinned source commit. The Cloud Ford scene composes them into
an original Ming-era inn and gateway; no upstream map, gameplay, story, names or
characters are included.

`SHA256SUMS` records every included GLB. Each local Git blob hash was also
compared with the matching file in the pinned upstream commit before release.
PNG files beside the GLBs are byte-for-byte extractions of their embedded image
bufferViews, using the filenames expected by the Godot importer.

Upstream license text:
<https://github.com/ToxSam/cc0-models-Polygonal-Mind/blob/56db2d4088512531a070d0bf3eb9d284d077528d/License.md>
